steps: 1. Run `/cos_regression_test` and require the full report to pass.
2. Apply a non-default Loremaster's Armoury hat, one primary-weapon illusion, and one offhand illusion. Keep a second unmodified weapon of the same type as a control.
3. Fully exit the game and relaunch; confirm all three choices restore on the same career and exact weapon instance while the control remains unchanged.
4. Run `/cos_persist_dump` and confirm no synthetic regression entries remain.
5. Run `/cos_persist_clear`, fully restart once more, and confirm the cleared choices do not return.
assertions: The hat, primary illusion, and offhand illusion survive a cold restart only on their saved career and exact weapon instance; the control stays untouched; the regression report passes; clearing persistence prevents every cleared choice from resurrecting. No cosmetic bleeds to another loadout or item.
Two-launch harness: seed hat+primary+offhand, quit, relaunch, assert la_persisted_equips rows and spawned unit names per backend id; control unchanged; clear, relaunch, assert empty.
